text:
maria: quick sync — planning to flip the unpinned default model for /v1/generate next month. what timeline should we communicate? need to confirm SDK behavior and server-side fallback.

alex: timeline? are we still aiming for canary 2026-05-10?

maria: yes, canary 2026-05-10 -> wide 2026-05-24 if no regressions. question: requests without `Model-Pin` header — will they get the new default immediately or stay on the legacy default per-account? cc @sam

sam: current runtime behavior: no header -> uses account default model version (legacy). if we flip the platform default, those no-header calls will start getting the new model. we should provide a compatibility path for apps that expect old outputs.

jordan: can we ship a negotiation header like `Model-Pin` or `Accept-Model` so callers can opt into the new default, and keep legacy routing for existing API keys for 30 days?

alex: +1. propose a 3-step rollout: 1) announce + SDK warning messages, 2) add opt-in `model_pin` param/header and rollout canary, 3) switch platform default but keep header-based opt-out for 30 days.

maria: specific asks for eng-platform: add `Model-Pin` header support in the gateway and ensure SDKs set `Model-Pin` if user pins via client. also tag telemetry with `default_flip=true` when newly-routed.

sam: I'll open a small PR for gateway header handling and unit tests. rough snippet I plan to use: 
```
# gateway pseudocode
headers_whitelist += ["Model-Pin"]
if request.headers.get('Model-Pin'):
    route_to_pinned_model(request.headers['Model-Pin'])
else:
    route_to_account_default(request.api_key)
```

pr-deploy-bot: Deploy queued: staging/gateway @sam #12345

maria: ops ask: what are rollback criteria? need thresholds for token-cost, latency, and quality regressions.

jordan: suggest rollback if p50 latency increases >20ms OR golden-set quality score drops >1% OR token cost per 1k > +10%.

sam: noted. I'll wire those metrics and add an alert + runbook for rollback steps.

alex: also update changelog + migration guide in docs, and ping SDK owners to add integration tests that assert `Model-Pin` behavior.

maria: thanks — action items: sam -> PR + tests, alex -> docs PR, jordan -> rollout monitor dashboards, I'll draft customer comms and timing. anyone else?

jordan: I'll draft the customer note and the suggested snippet showing header usage. :thumbsup:

maria: great. tagging for async follow-ups. (reaction :eyes:)
